tools.name: get_worth
tools.description: Use for a current second-hand value check: returns low/typical/high price estimate plus confidence for an item, from tracked eBay/Discogs marketplace data in GBP. Read-only and free for cached items. Example: q="used playstation 5 console".

tools.name: check_deal
tools.description: Use when the user has a specific asking price to judge: compares it with the tracked market range and returns a verdict (great deal, good deal, fair price, above average, overpriced). Read-only and free. Example: q="iphone 13 128gb used", price=320.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Use for price trends over time: returns tracked daily price snapshots for an item (history starts when tracking began and may be short). Read-only and free. For a single current value prefer get_worth.

tools.name: get_sold
tools.description: Use for real completed transactions: returns median/low/high sold prices from the operator's own eBay shop. Read-only and free. Prefer this for actual sold comparables; get_worth is for live asking-price estimates.
